issues_found: event_type is set to 'unknown' when a more specific classification (e.g., 'balance_sheet_update' or 'monetary_policy_report') is appropriate for reference rate data
Source is mechanical reference rate data with no policy signal, no commentary, and no narrative—excessively thin for standalone archival value
The 3.64% EFFR is the actual overnight transaction rate, not the FOMC target midpoint (3.875%), but the record does not clarify this distinction to readers
Record provides no temporal context linking this snapshot to any FOMC meeting, policy decision, or market event
Per CORE RULE 6: thin low-signal sources bias toward reject
human_review_reason: Record is factually accurate and source is properly attributed, but the source type (raw data snapshot) and lack of narrative content clearly meet rejection criteria under CORE RULE 6. Human review is not needed to render this verdict.
